body:
`LIBS` won't do anything in case of iOS, since it's building static library.

Instead, AccessKit library it should be copies into the bundle, here [platform_methods.py#L256](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fa6cad230f638d65a5a897008c5fc512edc237ad/platform_methods.py#L256)

Added to the project template here [project.pbxproj](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/misc/dist/apple_embedded_xcode/godot_apple_embedded.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj), probably dynamically to allow building with and w/o AccessKit with the same template, see [export_plugin.cpp#L412-L423](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fa6cad230f638d65a5a897008c5fc512edc237ad/platform/ios/export/export_plugin.cpp#L412-L423) and how `$moltenvk_` string are handled.
